instruction: I need to rename a folder on the desktop from "course_materials_spring" to "course_materials_summer". Can you do that?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires renaming directory from 'course_materials_spring' to 'course_materials_summer'. Evaluator checks if the renamed directory exists using shell command. This variation uses a seasonal course materials pattern.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete verification coverage: The shell command correctly checks BOTH conditions required for rename verification
Condition 1 (new folder exists): [ -d ~/Desktop/course_materials_summer ] verifies the renamed folder exists
Condition 2 (old folder removed): [ ! -d ~/Desktop/course_materials_spring ] verifies the original folder no longer exists
Logical correctness: Uses && operator to ensure both conditions must be true for success message
Prevents false positives: Will correctly fail if user only created a new folder (copy) or failed to remove the old one
The evaluator can semantically distinguish between rename (old gone, new exists), copy (both exist), and failure (old exists, new doesn't)
